name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: HBD date picker: a click-triggered calendar popover on the shared .hbd-field chrome (@hbd/input) plus a Radix-portalled non-modal (aria-modal="false", no backdrop/scroll-lock) panel. The panel holds a month header (prev/next nav + Intl month-year label), a weekday columnheader row, and a 6×7 APG grid (role="grid" / role="gridcell" + aria-selected + aria-current="date" + per-cell aria-label, roving tabindex, full keyboard date nav: Arrow/Home/End/PageUp/PageDown±Shift-year, Enter/Space select, Escape close), then a Today/Clear/Cancel/Confirm footer. Three variants: "date" (single), "date-time" (single + an embedded TimePicker, payload YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM), "date-range" (start/end with hover-preview). Committed-vs-pending model: opening snapshots saved→pending; cell clicks / Today / Clear mutate pending only and keep the panel open; Confirm commits (fires onValueChange/onRangeChange/onChange) + returns focus; Cancel and Escape discard + return focus; outside-pointerdown discards without returning focus. Radix Popover supplies portal + focus-trap + Escape/outside dismissal + return-focus; the legacy .hbd-date-picker* BEM classes are re-applied to the Radix parts so the de-shadowed date-picker.css renders 1:1. Native Intl.DateTimeFormat drives month/weekday/cell-label text; plain Date arithmetic drives nav (no date library). Controlled-first: value+defaultValue (single/date-time), valueStart/valueEnd+defaultValueStart/defaultValueEnd (range), open+defaultOpen+onOpenChange, plus onOpen/onClose bridging the WC's hbd:open/hbd:close.
